newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 15-day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 15-day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Monday it was setting a tender for 15-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts on Tuesday and the securities have to be repurchased on June 11.
The tender, which is usually announced on Tuesday, was pushed forward one day due to Thursday's national holiday.
A 60.6 billion mark facility set at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent expires on Tuesday. A 14-day facility was set last week at a fixed 3.00 percent at 84.0 billion marks.
